notes.config_discrepancy: PHASE2_REQUIRE_LAST_FOLD_POSITIVE defaults to False (config.py:630), not True as stated in the task spec. Test test_val_ret_positive monkeypatches it to True to test the gate.
notes.dual_gate_trigger: When val_ret <= 0.0, both val_ret_positive and val_return_floor fire simultaneously (val_ret_min defaults to 0.0). This is expected — the gates are independent AND conditions that happen to share the same threshold.
notes.no_behavior_change: The new function is purely additive. It is only called from the new log-only path in evox_runner.py. Existing feasibility logic is unchanged.
notes.lazy_import: The import of _feasibility_gate_failures inside the if val_count < 10 block avoids the import cost for the common case (val_count >= 10).
